prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240,initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#e1efee}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe1efee);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const V = (x,y,z) => new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const pi = Math.PI;
function group(parent,name){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function material(color,roughness=.76){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
}
const skin = material(0xffca32);
const eyeInk = material(0x30201b,.48);
const nostril = material(0xc48c25);
const tongueMat = material(0xf57872,.52);
const character = group(scene,'大笑奶龙 · Laughing Nailong');
const trunk = group(character,'Pear-shaped body');

function surface(parent,name,nu,nv,point,mat,colorAt){
  const pos=[], idx=[], colors=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=nv;j++){
    for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++){
      const u=i/nu,v=j/nv,p=point(u,v);
      pos.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
      if(colorAt){
        const c=colorAt(u,v);
        colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      }
    }
  }
  for(let j=0;j<nv;j++) for(let i=0;i<nu;i++){
    const a=j*(nu+1)+i,b=a+1,c=a+nu+1,d=c+1;
    idx.push(a,b,c,b,d,c);
  }
  const geom=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geom.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  if(colorAt) geom.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geom.setIndex(idx);
  geom.computeVertexNormals();
  const obj=new THREE.Mesh(geom,mat);
  obj.name=name;
  parent.add(obj);
  return obj;
}
function ball(parent,name,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,mat){
  const o=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,32),mat);
  o.name=name;
  o.position.set(x,y,z);
  o.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);
  parent.add(o);
  return o;
}
function spline(rows,t){
  const k=Math.max(0,Math.min(rows.length-1,t*(rows.length-1)));
  const i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(k)),s=k-i;
  const a=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=rows[i],c=rows[i+1],d=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
  return b.map((v,n)=>.5*((2*v)+(-a[n]+c[n])*s+
    (2*a[n]-5*v+4*c[n]-d[n])*s*s+(-a[n]+3*v-3*c[n]+d[n])*s*s*s));
}
const bodyProfile=[
  [.005,.005,.16,-.03],[.63,.54,.20,-.01],[.93,.76,.40,.04],
  [1.105,.895,.78,.075],[1.14,.925,1.12,.075],[1.04,.85,1.48,.035],
  [.835,.69,1.85,-.025],[.665,.58,2.16,-.09],[.60,.54,2.45,-.11],
  [.49,.43,2.60,-.12],[.005,.005,2.65,-.12]
];
surface(trunk,'Golden belly and neck',96,72,(u,v)=>{
  const [rx,rz,y,z]=spline(bodyProfile,v),a=u*2*pi;
  return V(rx*Math.sin(a),y,z+rz*Math.cos(a));
},skin);

function softLimb(parent,name,rows,mat){
  return surface(parent,name,48,48,(u,v)=>{
    const p=spline(rows,v);
    const p0=spline(rows,Math.max(0,v-.001)),p1=spline(rows,Math.min(1,v+.001));
    const dir=V(p1[0]-p0[0],p1[1]-p0[1],p1[2]-p0[2]).normalize();
    const axis=V(0,0,1);
    if(Math.abs(dir.z)>.95) axis.set(0,1,0);
    const h=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(dir,axis).normalize();
    const k=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(h,dir).normalize();
    return V(p[0],p[1],p[2]).addScaledVector(h,Math.cos(2*pi*u)*p[3])
      .addScaledVector(k,Math.sin(2*pi*u)*p[4]);
  },mat);
}
const tail=group(character,'Tapered dinosaur tail');
surface(tail,'Upturned tail',64,56,(u,v)=>{
  const [x,y,z,rx,ry]=spline([
    [.07,.75,-.38,.57,.48],[.14,.69,-.76,.49,.39],
    [.24,.62,-1.07,.33,.26],[.38,.66,-1.34,.19,.16],
    [.50,.76,-1.52,.089,.094],[.55,.85,-1.61,.003,.003]
  ],v),a=2*pi*u;
  return V(x+rx*Math.cos(a),y+ry*Math.sin(a),z);
},skin);
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const side=s<0?'Left':'Right';
  const leg=group(character,side+' leg and foot');
  const thigh=ball(leg,'Haunch',s*.625,.43,-.015,.42,.435,.47,skin);
  thigh.rotation.z=-s*.12;
  const foot=ball(leg,'Rounded foot',s*.65,.217,.235,.425,.217,.55,skin);
  foot.rotation.y=s*.18;

  const arm=group(character,side+' arm');
  const lift=s<0?.07:0;
  softLimb(arm,'Bent flipper-like arm',[
    [s*.64,1.73,.035,.13,.14],[s*.82,1.63,.11,.238,.25],
    [s*1.01,1.42,.24,.226,.23],[s*1.09,1.32+lift,.40,.20,.20],
    [s*1.09,1.34+lift,.55,.173,.172],[s*1.06,1.40+lift,.65,.118,.119],
    [s*1.045,1.44+lift,.69,.012,.012]
  ],skin);
  const hand=group(arm,'Little hand');
  ball(hand,'Thumb',s*.966,1.42+lift,.56,.097,.132,.111,skin).rotation.z=-s*.33;
}

const head=group(character,'Laughing head');
head.position.set(0,2.84,.015);
head.rotation.x=-.085;
head.rotation.z=-.035;
const mouth=group(head,'Wide open laughing mouth');
const limit=1.34;
function rim(a){
  const c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a);
  const w=Math.abs(a)<limit ? Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.cos(a*pi/(2*limit))),1.48) : 0;
  const seam=-.157+.205*Math.exp(-Math.pow((Math.abs(a)-1.05)/.49,2));
  const upper=V(1.055*s,seam+.242*w,.015+.965*c+.103*w);
  const lower=V((1.055-.087*w)*s,seam-.555*w,.015+.965*c-.135*w);
  return [lower,upper,w];
}
function crown(a,t){
  const [,r]=rim(a);
  const c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a);
  const rows=[
    [r.x,r.y,r.z],
    [1.059*s,r.y+.063,r.z+.014*c],
    [1.026*s,.222+.02*(1-c),.009+.965*c],
    [.902*s,.423,-.028+.819*c],
    [.726*s,.586,-.061+.672*c],
    [.485*s,.711,-.075+.465*c],
    [.249*s,.776,-.079+.244*c],
    [.002*s,.796,-.079+.002*c]
  ];
  return V(...spline(rows,t));
}
surface(head,'Domed head and soft upper muzzle',120,56,(u,v)=>crown((u*2-1)*pi,v),skin);
surface(head,'Rounded lower jaw',120,42,(u,v)=>{
  const a=(u*2-1)*pi,[r,,w]=rim(a),c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a);
  return V(...spline([
    [.002*s,-.902,-.049+.002*c],[.44*s,-.854,-.047+.425*c],
    [.705*s,-.750-.045*w,-.029+.60*c],
    [.92*s,-.447-.306*w,-.017+.761*c],
    [r.x*.995,r.y-.066,r.z-.019*c],[r.x,r.y,r.z]
  ],v));
},skin);

function inner(a,v){
  const [lo,hi,w]=rim(a);
  const p=lo.clone().lerp(hi,v);
  const inset=Math.sin(pi*v)*w;
  p.z-=.455*inset;
  p.x*=1-.105*inset;
  return p;
}
const lining=material(0xffffff,.85);
lining.vertexColors=true;
const wine=new THREE.Color(0x521e23),warm=new THREE.Color(0x9f4343);
surface(mouth,'Deep red mouth interior',100,40,
  (u,v)=>inner((2*u-1)*limit,v),lining,
  (u,v)=>wine.clone().lerp(warm,.55*(1-v)**2+.19*Math.abs(2*u-1)**3));
const tongue=group(mouth,'Tongue');
surface(tongue,'Curved pink tongue',72,30,(u,v)=>{
  const x=u*2-1,a=.923*x;
  const width=Math.sqrt(Math.max(.00001,1-x*x));
  const high=.195+.14*width-.028*Math.exp(-x*x/.032);
  const low=.195-.175*width;
  const p=inner(a,low+(high-low)*v);
  p.z+=.012+.102*Math.sin(v*pi)*width;
  return p;
},tongueMat);

const eyes=group(head,'Eyes squeezed shut with laughter');
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(eyes,s<0?'Left smiling eye':'Right smiling eye');
  surface(eye,'Curved dark eyelid',24,44,(u,v)=>{
    const q=v*2-1;
    const a=s*(.47+.196*q);
    const t=.444+.061*(1-q*q)+.006*q;
    const p=crown(a,t);
    const r=.003+.035*Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.sin(pi*v)),.6);
    const angle=2*pi*u;
    p.y+=Math.cos(angle)*r;
    p.z+=.012+Math.sin(angle)*r;
    return p;
  },eyeInk);
  const p=crown(s*.159,.207);
  const n=ball(head,'Tiny nostril',p.x,p.y+.001,p.z+.005,.028,.014,.013,nostril);
  n.rotation.z=-s*.24;
}

const sky=new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8ed,0xffe1ad,1.85);
scene.add(sky);
function light(x,y,z,color,intensity){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
light(-4,7,5,0xfff5dc,2.05);
light(4,3,-5,0xfff2c3,1.65);
light(4,2,5,0xe3f5ff,.49);

const shadowMat=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  transparent:true,depthWrite:false,
  uniforms:{shade:{value:new THREE.Color(0x738f89)}},
  vertexShader:'varying vec2 st; void main(){st=uv*2.-1.;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.);}',
  fragmentShader:`varying vec2 st;uniform vec3 shade;
  void main(){float d=dot(st,st);gl_FragColor=vec4(shade,.24*pow(max(0.,1.-d),3.));
  #include <colorspace_fragment>
  }`
});
const shadow=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3.4,2.7),shadowMat);
shadow.name='Soft contact shadow';
shadow.rotation.x=-pi/2;
shadow.position.y=-.004;
scene.add(shadow);

const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.07,2.07,2.07,-2.07,.1,50);
ref.position.set(2.24,2.61,10.5);
ref.lookAt(0,1.82,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();
const characters=[character];
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
